regime_context: Detector shows a narrow, one-narrative tape: Banks alone are eligible and dominant (score 0.907, breadth 0.833, crowded), with only 2/22 themes eligible and no confirmation of any handoff. Critically, gate_helps is false — on China A-shares history the absolute-trend gate did not reduce drawdown (mean-reverting market whipsaws it), so the one validated edge is explicitly absent here; everything else (rank, crowding, rotation) is coincident. Given that, and a track_record dir_accuracy of just 0.373, I keep conviction low and avoid inventing directional certainty.
emerging_watch: Watching Gold Miners (rank 2, score 0.68, the only challenger to Banks' leadership). It is ineligible (durability 0.38, breadth 0.167) so this is purely a watch, not a call. The condition that would retire this watch: Gold Miners either become eligible with a rise in durability_bar above the 0.75 gate AND Banks' score drops below challenger status, OR Gold Miners' score falls decisively (below ~0.4) confirming no handoff is forming.

theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible theme with a strong, cohesive trend signature (score 0.907, durability 0.75, breadth 0.833) — but momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha, and the trend gate did not hold on this market. The lean is a cautious continuation of the prevailing narrative while it remains intact, not an edge claim. The crowding flag (z 1.82, crowded true) and one_narrative structure argue for humility rather than conviction.
evidence: rotation.leader is Banks; no challenger above eligibility
theses.dissent: This is exactly the mean-reverting tape where the absolute-trend gate historically failed; the dominant crowded one-narrative theme is a classic place for a sharp shake-out, and fading it is forbidden but holding it unhedged has no validated drawdown protection here.
